|game_text=Deploy on table. During your deploy phase, if Carbonite Chamber Console on table, may use 1 Force to deploy an Effect from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If opponent’s just lost character is about to be removed from Lost Pile, may lose 1 Force to capture (imprison or let escape) that character instead. (Immune to Alter.)

|notes=The set was released 21 November 2003. The complete first sheet remains unlocated. The comparison dates each surviving issuer text. [https://web.archive.org/web/20031202154611id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm Players Committee release announcement]. The first surviving text can imprison in any prison or put the card in the opponent’s Used Pile. The remaster makes this capture with its imprison-or-escape choices. The alternative Effect deployment retains the cost, console condition and ordinary owner deployment timing. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=135 Period capture and escape examples].
